name: zoom-slider

changelog.summary: Added prefers-reduced-motion support: drag/scroll lerp collapses to direct tracking with no momentum glide, hover text uses a fade instead of a line-slide, and the hover image-scale is skipped

title: Zoom Slider
description: Infinitely looping horizontal image carousel where the active card expands using a quadratic easing curve as it enters from the right. Supports scroll, drag, and touch. Hover reveals GSAP SplitText line animations above each card.
